title: Get Bose QC Headphones for Less Than $200
gist: This is a Wired shopping roundup of Bose discounts. The headline deal is the Bose QuietComfort Headphones (2nd Gen) at a record-low $199 on Amazon (45% off $359). QC Ultra Headphones, QC Ultra Earbuds, Soundlink Plus and TV Speaker are also on sale, and the author recommends skipping the 1st-gen QC at $169.

themes.theme: QuietComfort 2nd Gen at its lowest price ever

insights.claim: Bose QuietComfort Headphones (2nd Gen) are at $199 on Amazon (down from $359, 45% off) and $219 at Bose. It is their lowest price ever and their first major discount since launching over the summer, and prices vary by colorway between $199 and $219.
insights.speaker: Harry Rabinowitz
insights.so_what: An early, steep discount on a product launched months ago suggests Bose is pricing aggressively ahead of the holidays.
insights.quote: This is the lowest price ever for these headphones, and their first major discount since launching over the summer.
insights.locator: This is the lowest price ever

insights.claim: The reviewer's main complaint about the QC 2nd Gen was that its price sat awkwardly between midrange and premium, and the discount removes that concern.
insights.speaker: Harry Rabinowitz
insights.so_what: The product's appeal depends on its price, so full MSRP may be hard to hold.
insights.quote: one of my major gripes was price, as they float in a strange middle ground between midrange and premium.
insights.locator: In my review of these headphones

insights.claim: Other Bose deals: QuietComfort Ultra Headphones (2nd Gen) at $369 (from $449, 18% off), QuietComfort Ultra Earbuds (2nd Gen) at $229 (from $299, 23% off), Soundlink Plus at $179 (from $269, 33% off) and TV Speaker (2nd Gen) at $199 on Amazon (from $299, 33% off), at Amazon, Best Buy and Bose.
insights.speaker: Harry Rabinowitz
insights.so_what: Bose is discounting broadly across its lineup, 18-33% off, at major retailers.
insights.locator: Other Good Bose Deals Right Now

insights.claim: The reviewer advises against the Bose QuietComfort Headphones (1st Gen) at $169 (from $359), because the second generation costs only about $30 more.
insights.speaker: Harry Rabinowitz
insights.so_what: Closing out the previous generation at a small discount relative to the new one points to inventory clearance.
insights.quote: For $30 more (depending on colorway), you can get the new second-generation version.
